# Compact route API fixture

These are two real Rantalantie runtime chunks plus the complete immutable
runtime manifest, SHA-256 `74e4c9affb0d880868fb2cfe9f57bf87029c4e1cf7c60ca87ced3201831f9951`.
They are derived by `tools/Pack-RouteNetwork.py` from the unchanged audited
canonical source in `../route-network`. Tests compare every retained node,
coordinate and mode/direction flag with that source, and compare actual Foot
and Bicycle route results. This fixture is not deployed as country coverage.
Public OpenStreetMap-derived database, ODbL-1.0; source/date are in manifest.json.
